# Mapping Africa — 2022

> Benchmark chips for Africa (Mapping Africa sites) cut from the 2022 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection lacuna.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/lacuna_2022_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/lacuna_2022_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/lacuna_2022_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2022/items.parquet)
